title: LLM Wiki page frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter required at the top of every wiki page. Validated by `wikikit validate`.

type.description: Page kind; determines which pages/<dir> it lives in.

slug.description: Kebab-case identifier. MUST equal the filename without .md. Used as the [[slug]] link target.

updated.description: Last-updated date, YYYY-MM-DD. Bump it on every edit.

tags.description: Free-form tags for grouping / Dataview queries.

sources.description: Provenance: slugs of the source pages that support this page's claims.

source_file.description: For type=source pages: path (relative to sources/) of the raw file this page summarizes.
